research_question: Under identical backbone, source components, evaluator, seed family, token budget and objective, when should data-mixture choice be optimized by real-data training, trained proxies, merged proxies, or post-hoc distribution-vector composition?

paths.ratio_selection: versioned trained-proxy predictor under identical source simplex
merge component models, evaluate merged proxies, train predictor, then retrain selected real-data mixture
seeded Bayesian optimization over distribution-vector weights
